chunks: Come to believe in God and His Apostle, and struggle in the cause of God with your wealth and your souls. That will be good for you, if you can understand.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of striving with wealth and selves in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to establish the obligation of jihad as a comprehensive act of worship that integrates material sacrifice (mal) and personal effort (nafs), reflecting the holistic nature of faith. It underscores the principle that true belief is validated through active struggle in God's path, a concept central to the Shia understanding of the 'Greater Jihad' and the role of the faithful in establishing justice.
